title: 第15章 你的任务最艰巨第16章 成功了
lines: 第15章你的任务最艰巨！
王良此时也正在看直播，他本想看看穆锡的表现，可惜万雄一个镜头都没给。
变异副本虽然很少出现，但这么多年，他也看到过很多次。
网上相关的视频更是不计其数，对他来说也没什么可看的。
正准备退出直播间的时候，却突然在万雄的镜头里，发现从另一个方向远远走过来几个人。
刘志远、姬彩衣、单谷、司音……还有白牧野？
怎么可能是他们？
王良心里很惊讶。
前面四个，还没入学的时候王良就已经听说过。
小学和初中两个阶段几乎没有官方组织的比赛。
都是打基础的年龄，官方并不鼓励孩子太小就参加各种比赛。
就像很多家长不想让孩子太早接触虚拟仓一样。
会分心。
但民间在私下里还是会有一些小规模比赛。
刘志远这些人在那种比赛中经常拿第一，也引起过一些人的关注，算是小有名气。
可是在这种变异副本里面，他们那点实力，真的不够看！
这并非王良看不起人，而是事实如此。
高一的学生，哪怕是基础非常好的那种，也需要经过不断的深入学习和修炼，才会逐渐变得强大起来。
不排除有那种变态的妖孽孩子存在，可百城这种地方，几百年都未必能出现一个。没人敢奢望这种事儿。
“这几个小家伙，运气有点逆天，胆子也真是够大的……不对！”
王良嘴里嘀咕着，随着那几个人越走越近，他的眼睛也不断瞪大。
事实跟他想象的，好像有点不一样啊！
他当了这么多年老师，自身也是一个高级灵战士，怎么能看不出那群孩子身上的气势？
他们经历了什么？哪来的自信？
就连精神力只有二十的白牧野，都一副神采飞扬的样子……这太奇怪了！
尤其是刘志远他们身上都带着血迹和战斗过的痕迹，很显然不是因为运气才来到城中心广场的。
这让王良对他们这支团队，隐隐的，生出了几分期待。
他没有急着退出直播间，而是继续安静的观看起来。
城中心广场的边缘，两支队伍，不期而遇。
“你们怎么来了？”穆锡一脸惊讶的看着刘志远等人，目光最后落到白牧野身上。看着有些灰头土脸的白牧野，穆锡嘴角露出一抹淡淡的不屑。
万雄看着姬彩衣，微笑道：“不错！”
“运气好。”姬彩衣点点头，淡淡回了一句。
直播间里面，顿时炸了。
“哇，大美女啊！”
“这女生是谁呀？很傲娇啊！怎么见到咱雄哥不冷不热的，架子这么大？”
“一中的学生吧？能在变异副本打到城中心广场的，估计也只有一中的人了。”
“这下有意思了，他们是要组队一起推最后的守护兽吗？”
万雄没有理会直播间里面的动静，看着姬彩衣道：“一起吧。”
姬彩衣摇摇头：“你们打你们的。”
万雄看了一眼身边的几个人：“宝箱让给他们吧，回头我补偿你们。”
李秋风和潘相文以及司空菲云三人对万雄的心思清楚的很，变异宝箱再怎么有价值，也不如万雄的承诺价值高。
如果不是万雄，他们在之前的飞仙星高中生联赛上怎么可能获得第九名的好成绩？
所以三人全都随意的点点头。
content_en:
Chapter 15 Your task is the most difficult!
Wang Liang was also watching the live broadcast at this time. He wanted to see Mu Xi's performance, but unfortunately Wan Xiong didn't give him a single shot.
Although mutated copies rarely appear, he has seen them many times over the years.
There are countless related videos on the Internet, and there is nothing for him to watch.
Just as he was about to exit the live broadcast room, Wan Xiong suddenly spotted several people walking far away from the other direction in Wan Xiong's camera.
Liu Zhiyuan, Ji Caiyi, Shan Gu, Si Yin...and Bai Muye?
How could it be them?
Wang Liang was very surprised.
Wang Liang had already heard of the first four before he entered school.
There are almost no officially organized competitions at the primary and junior high school levels.
These are the ages for laying the foundation. Officials do not encourage children to participate in various competitions when they are too young.
Just like many parents don’t want their children to be exposed to virtual warehouses too early.
Will be distracting.
But there are still some small-scale competitions among private citizens.
People like Liu Zhiyuan often take first place in such competitions, and have attracted some people's attention, so they are somewhat famous.
But in this mutated copy, their little strength is really not enough!
This is not because Wang Liang looks down on people, but it is the fact.
Students in the first year of high school, even those with a very good foundation, will gradually become stronger after continuous in-depth study and practice.
We can't rule out the existence of such perverted monster children, but in a place like Hundred Cities, one may not appear in hundreds of years. No one dares to hope for such a thing.
"These little guys are a bit lucky and very courageous... No!"
Wang Liang muttered, his eyes widening as those people came closer and closer.
The reality seems to be a little different from what he imagined!
He has been a teacher for so many years and is also a high-level spiritual warrior himself. How could he not see the aura in those children?
What have they experienced? Where does the confidence come from?
Even Bai Muye, who has only twenty mental powers, looks in high spirits... This is so strange!
In particular, Liu Zhiyuan and the others all had blood stains and traces of battle on their bodies. It was obvious that they did not come to the central square because of luck.
This made Wang Liang vaguely look forward to their team.
He did not rush out of the live broadcast room, but continued to watch quietly.
…
…
On the edge of the city's central square, two teams met unexpectedly.
"Why are you here?" Mu Xi looked at Liu Zhiyuan and others in surprise, and finally his eyes fell on Bai Muye. Looking at the gray-faced Bai Muye, a hint of disdain appeared at the corner of Mu Xi's mouth.
Wan Xiong looked at Ji Caiyi and smiled: "Not bad!"
"Good luck." Ji Caiyi nodded and replied lightly.
The live broadcast room suddenly exploded.
"Wow, what a beauty!"
"Who is this girl? She's so arrogant! Why do you think our brother Xiong is so lukewarm and so arrogant?"
"A student from No. 1 Middle School, right? The only ones who can reach the central square of the city in the mutated dungeon are probably the only ones from No. 1 Middle School."
"Now it's interesting. Are they going to team up to push the last guardian beast together?"
Wan Xiong ignored the movement in the live broadcast room, looked at Ji Caiyi and said, "Let's get together."
Ji Caiyi shook her head: "You beat yourselves."
Wan Xiong glanced at the people around him: "Leave the treasure box to them, and I will make it up to you later."
Li Qiufeng, Pan Xiangwen and Sikong Feiyun were very clear about Wan Xiong's thoughts. No matter how valuable the mutated treasure chest was, it was not as valuable as Wan Xiong's promise.
If it weren't for Wan Xiong, how could they have achieved ninth place in the previous Feixianxing High School League?
So all three of them nodded casually.
